Age: Age of the patient, numerical, years
HR: Heart rate of the patient, numerical, bpm
K: Potassium level in blood, numerical, meq/L
Na: Sodium level in blood, numerical, meq/L
Cl: Chloride level in blood, numerical, meq/L
Ca: Calcium level in blood, numerical, mg/dL
IonisedCa: Ionised calcium level in blood, numerical, mg/dL
CO2: Carbon dioxide level in blood, numerical, meq/L
Albumin: Albumin level in blood, numerical, g/dL
Hb: Hemoglobin level in blood, numerical, g/dL
HCO3: Bicarbonate level in blood, numerical, meq/L
FiO2: Fraction of inspired oxygen, numerical, fraction
BUN: Blood urea nitrogen level, numerical, mg/dL
Creatinine: Creatinine level in blood, numerical, mg/dL
Mg: Magnesium level in blood, numerical, mg/dL
WbcCount: White blood cell count, numerical, E9/L
PaO2: Partial pressure of oxygen in blood, numerical, mmHg
PaCO2: Partial pressure of carbon dioxide in blood, numerical, mmHg
Lactate: Lactate level in blood, numerical, mmol/L
InputTotal: Total IV fluids volume, numerical, mL
Input4H: IV fluids volume per 4 hours, numerical, mL
MaxVaso: Maximum dose of vasopressors per 4 hours, numerical, mcg/kg/min
Output4H: Urine output per 4 hours, numerical, mL
GCS: Glasgow Coma Scale, categorical, ranging from 3 to 15
PTT: Partial thromboplastin time in seconds, categorical
